question: Which section name must carry Characteristics so the RTL8139 NIC install can finish?
allowedInputs: drivers/network/dd/rtl8139/netrtl.inf RTL8139_Inst.ndi.NT already sets Characteristics to 0x4 and BusType to 5
dll/win32/setupapi/driver.c the models section name RealtekMfg has no Characteristics key, so indexing that name makes NetClassInstaller reject the NIC
